---
title: "Trap: a style the body face does not have"
mdbrand:
  brand: dejavu
  style: note
---

DejaVu Sans has no small caps, so NFSS sets [these words]{.smallcaps} in the
regular face and says so only in the log. Dosis did the same to every
*emphasis* in a wolfops document: the words printed, upright, and the build
exited 0.
